points.quote: `common` | Any JavaScript environment. It can't touch DOM or Node APIs. | Only `common`.
`browser` | The renderer or web, with DOM access. | `browser` and `common`
`node` | Node.js, with no DOM and no Electron. | `node` and `common`
`electron-browser` | The Electron renderer, with DOM plus a preload/Node bridge. | `electron-browser`, `browser` and `common`
